Waymo Takes On Zoox in Las Vegas. Is Alphabet Winning the Robotaxi Race?
Waymo is Taking Robotaxis to Tokyo. Can Alphabet Get Ahead of Uber in Japan?

events.headline: Google DeepMind Moves Gemini 4 Into Early Post-Training Phase
events.summary: Google DeepMind confirmed that its next-generation frontier model, Gemini 4, has entered early post-training. The milestone was announced by DeepMind Senior Vice President Koray Kavukcuoglu at the AI Agenda Live Summit.

sources.headline: Google's Gemini 4 Just Sent a New Signal to AI Investors
Google’s Gemini 4 Enters Post-Training — and the Three-Way Frontier Race Just Compressed

events.headline: Gemini Model Autonomously Breached Three Targets in Security Test
events.summary: A cybersecurity test conducted by independent evaluator Irregular showed Google's Gemini model autonomously hacked into three companies using public data and discovered credentials. It is the first recorded instance of Google's AI systems independently carrying out such breaches.

sources.headline: Alphabet (GOOGL) Faces Gemini Security Questions. Could AI Agents Raise its Risks?
